notes.title: Reynard Versoion 1.0.3 – Optimization, Bug Fixes and the Future
notes.content:
This week I focused on optimization and bug fixes. I also have some important news about the future of Reynard and Hyper Fox Studios.

A lot of people asked me if Reynard will be released on Nintendo Switch platform and I can finally reply that… IT WILL!!! Nintendo approved my developer account for Switch. This gave me another huge motivation boost!

Generally It means that I’ll be:
[list]
[*]Adding more new content (bosses, enemies, items…),
[*]Further optimize the game,
[*]Squish undiscovered and upcoming bugs!
[/list]

It’s good news, but I’ll have more expenses by getting the right hardware (Switch) etc. Besides that, my PC freezes from time to time. I really hope that he only has a “phase”.

I'm super happy that so many of you support Reynard. But I'm not able to live off our little fox :D So in the next couple of weeks, I'll try to earn enough money for the upcoming costs. I'll pick up some client work in web development. In these upcoming couple of weeks don't be mad if I'll be releasing only minor updates for Reynard.

Enough with the news! Here are the changes!
[list]
[*][b][MAJOR][/b] Movement and dash of Reynard and NPCs has been optimized. The game should run smooth now on 60 FPS.
[*][b][MINOR][/b] Added the FPS option – 60 FPS.
[*][b][MINOR][/b] Added the starting area blocades in Ferdinand’s level.
[*][b][MINOR][/b] When crafting, everything except equipment now gets added to your inventory automatically.
[*][b][BUGFIX][/b] Fixed the bug when you’d play on the easy mode and the perk would take away more stamina than allowed.
[*][b][BUGFIX][/b] Daily run on easy mode now loads starting items correctly.
[*][b][BUGFIX][/b] Mumu now deals damage over time.
[*][b][BUGFIX][/b] Effect zones of spawned cursed weapons don’t get blown away by the wind anymore.
[*][b][BUGFIX][/b] No more building stuff on player, enemy or ally ocuppied area in the invasion.
[*][b][BUGFIX][/b] Fixed a room cell which had a “physical” golden key in it.
[/list]

Until next time! I wish you an awesome weekend and happy dungeon crawling! 😀

notes.title: Reynard Version 1.0.1 – Difficulty Modes and Other Options
notes.content:
Hey there!

I couldn't sit still since I knew that some of you are struggling with the difficulty of the game... so I had a productive Sunday :)

[h1]Difficulty Modes[/h1]

As many of you guys requested, I've added the difficulty modes. Now if you'll play the updated version "1.0.1", you'll be asked what kind of an adventure you'd like to experience first time before you enter the dungeon.

Current options are "easy" and "normal". I'll later add "hard" and "foxlike" modes.

In easy mode you'll start with the "Crafted bow" which has a rune slot + homing missiles. You will also be granted an armor - "Island Protector" which is unbreakable, has 3 rune slots and reduces the "normal" damage by 30%. Besides these 2 items I've added a "Poor Max Stamina Boost" relic which increases your stamina by 10.

If you'll want to change the difficulty once you're comfortable, you can do this in the options menu.

I also have to warn you that the easy mode does not affect the daily runs! It just wouldn't be fair :)

Please let me know if this is good enough for easy mode or you want me to buff it more. I'd also like to hear if you have any special wishes for the upcoming hard and foxlike modes.

[h1]Other Options[/h1]

Some of you don't want the camera shake effect. I've added an option which disables it.

I've been also thinking that some of you may find the damage numbers disturbing, so now you can disable them aswell.

Untill next update I wish you happy dungeon crawling :D

notes.title: Reynard Full Release
notes.content:
I could be chasing version 1.0 for months or even years. But everything has to have a goal or at least a major milestone, and my main goal was to release a game that captures elements of my favorite genres in a good way. I think that my goal was achieved. Reynard has left the early access and I can’t wait for your feedback.

This is not the end! It’s a major milestone. I’ll continue to add improvements proposed by the community and my “imagination”.

I can bet that I’ll have to squash undiscovered bugs in the future and I’m pretty sure that I’ll have to start freelancing or find myself another job if I want to keep paying bills 😀

I’d like to thank Boštjan, Nika and all the supporters! We did it! Thank you so much for staying with me on this journey. It’s been a hell of a ride but I’d do it all over again.

I'd like to invite you to read the whole blog post about the release: http://hyperfoxstudios.com/reynard-full-release/

notes.title: Reynard Version 0.9.4 – Balancing, New Weapons and More
notes.content:
Hey there!

It's Friday and it's update time!

As said in our “Why early access?” section on steam... we want to involve our early access supporters in development of the game.

Because it’s not the first time that we’ve received a proposal for stamina to regenerate itself instantly once you clear the room, we've added this feature.

Some of our players also pointed out that they don’t see much sense in waiting for their health to regenerate if they have a health regeneration relic. They see it as an exploit. After thinking about it for some time, I’ve decided that they're right and that the relic should be removed. So it’s gone… for now :D

The whole point of the daily run is to achieve the highest score. Until now if you didn’t die… you could clear every room and in the end your score would be very similar to your rival’s score.

That’s why from now on speed and remaining gold is being rewarded. If you complete a run under 40, 30 or 25 minutes you’ll get 10000 bonus score for each mark. Also at the end of the run remaining gold now gets transformed into score.

There are a lot of changes... Like 2 new special weapons and more. I recommend that you check all the changes with shiny gifs on our blog post:
http://hyperfoxstudios.com/reynard-devlog-23-rebalancing-new-weapons/

For those in hurry:

[list]
[*][b][WEAPON][/b] Titan's Belt. Can spawn up to 4 circling discs around Reynard that stun and hurt attackers.
[*][b][WEAPON][/b] Luna's Cloak. Become invisible for 5 seconds. Invisibility stops if you attack.
[*][b][HUGE][/b] Stamina refills when transitioning through doors. Regeneration rate is increased when you clear the
room, you're waiting for the next wave or you defeat the boss.
[*][b][MINOR][/b] Wind can't spawn in forge rooms anymore.
[*][b][MINOR][/b] Added confetti to the win screen.
[*][b][MINOR][/b] Repositioned the HP bar of Xeno turret.

[*][b][MINOR][/b] Added more supporters to the book of credits.
[*][b][MINOR][/b] Speed is now being rewarded! If you complete a run under 40, 30 or 25 minutes you'll get 10000 bonus
score for each mark.
[*][b][MINOR][/b] At the end of the run remaining gold gets transformed into score.
[*][b][BALANCING][/b] Buffed the Ifrit's boot's fire damage and spread duration.
[*][b][BALANCING][/b] Reduced starting max stamina to 20.
[*][b][BALANCING][/b] Enemy loot drops in invasion are halved.
[*][b][BUGFIX][/b] Goblins don't steal from player when hitting his allies.
[*][b][BUGFIX][/b] Fixed lifestealing from corpses.
[*][b][BUGFIX][/b] Fixed jittering of a special weapon image on a HUD.
[*][b][BUGFIX][/b] Falling Boulders now deal normal damage instead of fire.

[/list]

PS: I'd really like to know how you like the game so far. If you have any recommendation I'd love to read it! You're welcome to join us on discord: https://discord.gg/vR3uHgJ where we chat about all sorts of stuff :)

notes.title: Reynard Version 0.9.1 – Boss Noc, Ally Judy and More
notes.content:
Hey there! 

It's Friday and another Reynard's update is ready :)

Until now the balance was in favor of Melee bosses. It would be wrong if it remained that way for a longer period. But it would be boring if the new Ranged boss would deal a “regular” ranged attack damage. That’s the reason I’ve created Noc.

Unlike other bosses he doesn’t have health dependent states! Noc is aggressive from the beginning. His mission is to chase Reynard and hit him with his darkening / ethereal fists. If Reynard get’s hit by his fist, his vision becomes limited.

Not only that he’s shooting dangerous projectiles, he’s also summoning cursed weapons!

Besides adding Noc I've added all sorts of new stuff! Read full post with flashy gifs and pics here: http://hyperfoxstudios.com/reynard-boss-noc-ally-judy/

[*][b][MINOR][/b] Drake now has a nice death animation and projects fire projectiles from correct position.
[*][b][MINOR][/b] Added SFX to “pawn” shrine.
[*][b][MINOR][/b] Added death animations to mobs.
[*][b][MINOR][/b] Crate buildings now display healthbars.
[*][b][MINOR][/b] Water can now appear instead of the abyss – More biome variations,
[*][b][MINOR][/b] Last hitting an enemy triggers mini camera shake.
[*][b][BALANCING][/b] Necro Staff’s kill count before summoning an ally skeleton is reduced from 15 to 10. Its damage has been incresed from 1 to 1.3.
[*][b][BALANCING][/b] Forest Child perk nerfed. It also takes 20% of player’s score and gold.

In the upcoming week I’ll focus on polishing stuff! I’ll probably add some map on the loading screen, so the player will know how far from saving Prascilla he is. I’ll try to add options to the ingame menu, fiddle with dungeon progression and as always… add a new enemy or ally.

Next Friday is after Christmas so I wish you a merry Christmas upfront 😀 Have fun beating Noc and Santa!

notes.title: Reynard Version 0.9.0 – Santa Boss, Zombies and More
notes.content:
Ho-ho-ho! Christmas is around the corner and Santa has come to visit Foen!

Since it’s December I wanted to add some Christmas spirit to Reynard’s universe.

Santa became another boss influenced by the powerful Wizco’s magic! But you can bring him back to his senses if you free him from the spell (beat him). Players who can defeat him will be rewarded with Santa’s costume!

Besides Santa I've added all sorts of new stuf! Read full post with shiny gifs and pics here: http://hyperfoxstudios.com/reynard-devlog-19-santa-boss-zombies-and-more-0-9-0/

For those in hurry:

- [b][BOSS][/b] Added a Santa Clause boss battle. Free him and unlock yourself a Santa's costume. You can start the battle by interacting with portal next to the fox hole. You'll be able to fight Santa from 12/12/EveryYear to 1/2/EveryYear.
- [b][ENEMY][/b] Added a Zombie. Immune to poison and necro damage. When it kills it's victim it restores 0.25 hp to self and spawns a new zombie on it's victim's place.
- [b][BALANCING][/b] Doctor Plague now spawns Zombies and Skeletons. His movement speed was increased for 50%. Has some companions from the beginning.
- [b][MINOR][/b] Removed a single pixel mistake on Reynard's Santa costume :)
- [b][BUGFIX][/b] Fixed bugged when golem's dropped golem's fist instead of golem's hand. (one is usable other is an actual weapon of the golem).
- [b][BUGFIX][/b] Wilson's laser beam can now damage allies and companions.
- [b][BUGFIX][/b] Doctor Plague can now damage allies and companions.
- [b][BUGFIX][/b] Fixed the bug when the stairs to secret room are spawned behind the indestructible objects.
- [b][BUGFIX][/b] Companion skeletons wouldn't get transported to other levels.

In the upcoming week I’ll focus on boss battles, new enemies and new rooms! If you’d like to recommend anything, please let me know!

Till next time! Happy Santa saving 😀

notes.title: Reynard version 0.8.9 – Tutorial, Death Cam, Chewie Companion, Skin and More
notes.content:
When getting feedback from players, I’ve noticed that very few of them figured out all of the game’s mechanics.

Many players didn’t know that there is crafting in the game, that you can charge your attack or that your attacks don’t deal knockback once you run out of stamina.

That’s why I’ve finally created an interactive tutorial, which also adds some value to the story.

Tutorial will start once you create a new profile.

Besides the tutorial I've added all sorts of new stuf! Read full post with shiny gifs and pics here: http://hyperfoxstudios.com/reynard-devlog-18-tutorial-death-cam-chewie-companion-skins-and-more-0-8-9/

For those in hurry:

- [b][FEATURE][/b] Tutorial section added. Every profile starts with a tutorial scene, which is skipable. Tutorial explains some of the lore so check it out.
- [b][FEATURE][/b] You can now enable death camera. It will record 3 seconds before you died in a gif format.
- [b][FEATURE][/b] You can now change Reynard’s clothes… Santa’s costume added.
- [b][ALLY][/b] Chewy joined the ranks of allies!
- [b][RECIPE][/b] Golem’s Plate – Golem’s hand + Poor normal Armor Rune.
- [b][INGREDIENT][/b] Golem’s Hand – Dropped by golems.
- [b][MINOR][/b] Added SFX to forge, chest, bat, rat, item pickup, item drop.
- [b][MINOR][/b] Removed the “+” sign from weapon damage.
- [b][MINOR][/b] Added a darker “belt” of water around islands.
- [b][MINOR][/b] Edited the chapter of supporters.
- [b][MINOR][/b] XP slider not annoying anymore. It’s faster. Thank you VooGzy!
- [b][BALANCING][/b] Molten Helmet’s fire resist reduced from 100% to 75%.
- [b][BALANCING][/b] Buffed Ferdinand’s base attack damage from 1 to 1.5.
- [b][BALANCING][/b] Necro bow now shoots only 1 arrow has increase knockback, damage and crit chance.
- [b][BALANCING][/b] Bubba’s potion prices have been increased.
- [b][BUGFIX][/b] Removed Boom Joe from Foen and his immunity to ice.
- [b][BUGFIX][/b] Fixed bugged acid rune.
- [b][BUGFIX][/b] Golden bomb now isn’t blown away from windy room.
- [b][BUGFIX][/b] Sometimes you could take items from shrine without paying.
- [b][BUGFIX][/b] Ferdinand’s SFX sound wouldn’t stop repeating in some case… even if you kill him.
- [b][SPOILER ALERT!][/b] Prascilla now appears back on the Island once you finish the game.

In the upcoming week I’ll focus on boss battles, new items and leaderboards… and bug fixes! If you’d like to recommend anything, please let me know!

Till next time! Happy dungeon crawling 😀

notes.title: Reynard version 0.8.8 – Ferdinand, Improved Armor Runes, Bugfixes and More
notes.content:
This is our first update since releasing Reynard on Steam. We call him Ferdinand. He's the meanest of them... for now.

To see all the "shiny" pictures and to read the full blog post, please visit our blog on: http://hyperfoxstudios.com/reynard-devlog-17-ferdinand-improved-armor-runes-bugfixes-and-more-0-8-8/ 

For those in hurry, here's a TL;DR;

[list]
[*] [b][BOSS][/b] New boss Ferdinand joined Reynard!
[*] [b][RECIPE][/b] Crafted Wooden Bow – Wooden Stick + Ordinary Rope.
[*] [b][RECIPE][/b] Bull’s Horns Helmet – Copper Plank + Poor Normal Armor Rune.
[*] [b][RECIPE][/b] Book of the Dead – Common Companion Boost + Common Max Health Boost.
[*] [b][RECIPE][/b] Necro Bow – Bone + Ordinary rope.
[*] [b][IMPORTANT][/b] Added ability to armor runes. They can now reflect the damage, slow the attacker or increase Reynard’s movement speed…
[*] [b][IMPORTANT][/b] Companions will now stay with you until they die or the run ends.
[*] [b][IMPORTANT][/b] Added a “second” secret to the Foen island.
[*] [b][BALANCING][/b] Necro Staff’s recipe changed to “Bone + Poor Necrotic Damage Rune” + Increased the crit chance to 1%.
[*] [b][BALANCING][/b]Pepe can now spawn in the basement dungeon.
[*] [b][BALANCING][/b] Stamina now refils on each scene change.
[*] [b][BALANCING][/b] Cobra’s poison projectile doesn’t have spreadable damage anymore.
[*] [b][BALANCING][/b] Golem’s health type set from “Ice” to “Normal”.
[*] [b][BALANCING][/b] Modified the Bubba’s prices.
[*] [b][MINOR] [/b]Added dialogue to the axe on the island (It sounds weird but it’s not :D).
[*] [b][MINOR][/b] Stamina now refils on each scene change.
[*] [b][MINOR] [/b]Added Prascilla’s Idle animation.
[*] [b][MINOR][/b] Renamed some Bronze stuff to Copper.
[*] [b][BUGFIX][/b] “Return” button now works as a confirm.
[*] [b][BUGFIX] /b] Fixed the bug when Wilson’s Beam wouldn’t stop playing when you die.

[/list]

[b]I’ll add the first player who figures out how to pull the axe out from the stump to the book of credits! [/b]

Since many new players have joined Reynard community and there is no official tutorial, I hope to have started one for next update. Expect more cool recipes, bosses and updates in the future. If you’d like to recommend something, please let me know!

Till next time! Happy dungeon crawling 😀
